entities.summary: Federico Baistrocchi was an Italian general during the interwar period and World War II. He served as State Undersecretary for War from 1933 to 1936 and as Chief of Staff of the Royal Italian Army from 1934 to 1936. He was also a member of the Chamber of Deputies and of the Senate of the Kingdom of Italy.
